newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT - US T-bonds well supported on dips.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - US T-bonds well supported on dips.

text.p: June U.S. Treasury bond futures moved lower in choppy fashion Thursday as support at 108-30 fortified prices on downward thrusts.
That level is the May 8 low, which served as the springboard for the leap to 110-22, the high of the recent upmove reached on May 13.
June futures were last trading at 109-01, down 8/32.
Technical analysts said futures would continue to find good support as prices now probed the low end of the trading range and noted a buy-on-dips mentality had taken hold.
